audit_subject_user.name: audit_subject_user
audit_subject_user.value: ("turnstile"."configuration_audit"."action" = 'access_changed' AND "turnstile"."configuration_audit"."actor_kind" = 'operator' AND "turnstile"."configuration_audit"."subject_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."configuration_audit"."subject_user_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$') OR ("turnstile"."configuration_audit"."action" <> 'access_changed' AND "turnstile"."configuration_audit"."subject_user_id" IS NULL)

configuration_zone_bound.name: configuration_zone_bound
configuration_zone_bound.value: "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."time_zone" IS NULL OR (octet_length("turnstile"."organization_configuration"."time_zone") = char_length("turnstile"."organization_configuration"."time_zone") AND char_length("turnstile"."organization_configuration"."time_zone") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

configuration_completion.name: configuration_completion
configuration_completion.value: ("turnstile"."organization_configuration"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."completed_by" IS NULL) OR ("turnstile"."organization_configuration"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."completed_by" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$' AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."root_id" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_configuration"."revision" > 0)

unit_shape.name: unit_shape
unit_shape.value: ("turnstile"."organization_unit"."type" = 'organization' AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."name" IS NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."name_key" IS NULL) OR ("turnstile"."organization_unit"."type" IN ('site', 'department') AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."parent_id" <> "turnstile"."organization_unit"."id" AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("turnstile"."organization_unit"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "turnstile"."organization_unit"."name_key" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("turnstile"."organization_unit"."name_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 240)

access_assignment_scope.name: access_assignment_scope
access_assignment_scope.value: ("turnstile"."access_assignment"."scope_kind" = 'company' AND NOT "turnstile"."access_assignment"."include_children" AND "turnstile"."access_assignment"."scope_key" = 'company') OR ("turnstile"."access_assignment"."scope_kind" = 'units' AND char_length("turnstile"."access_assignment"."scope_key") BETWEEN 43 AND 603)

access_receipt_structure_revisions.name: access_receipt_structure_revisions
access_receipt_structure_revisions.value: ("turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."organization_revision_after" IS NULL AND "turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."access_revision_after" IS NULL) OR ("turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."operation" IN ('unit.create','unit.rename','unit.delete','unit.move') AND "turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."organization_revision_after" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."access_revision_after" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."organization_revision_after" >= 0 AND "turnstile"."access_command_receipt"."access_revision_after" >= 0)

access_release_state.name: access_release_state
access_release_state.value: ("turnstile"."access_context"."release_id" IS NULL OR "turnstile"."access_context"."release_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("turnstile"."access_context"."recovery_epoch" IS NULL OR "turnstile"."access_context"."recovery_epoch" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("turnstile"."access_context"."released_by" IS NULL OR "turnstile"."access_context"."released_by" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$') AND (NOT "turnstile"."access_context"."public_writes_enabled" OR ("turnstile"."access_context"."release_id" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."access_context"."recovery_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."access_context"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."access_context"."released_at" IS NOT NULL))

invitation_audit_actor.name: invitation_audit_actor
invitation_audit_actor.value: "turnstile"."invitation_audit"."actor_kind" IN ('user','system') AND ("turnstile"."invitation_audit"."actor_kind"='system' OR "turnstile"."invitation_audit"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

invitation_delivery_lease.name: invitation_delivery_lease
invitation_delivery_lease.value: "turnstile"."invitation_delivery"."state"<>'sending' OR ("turnstile"."invitation_delivery"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."invitation_delivery"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

member_display_shape.name: member_display_shape
member_display_shape.value: "turnstile"."member_display"."state" IN ('present','deleted') AND "turnstile"."member_display"."member_version">0 AND ("turnstile"."member_display"."state"='deleted' OR ("turnstile"."member_display"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "turnstile"."member_display"."email" IS NOT NULL))
